title: Crestline Fleet Account Repeat Billing Error Credit on Tire Corrections
content:
A Crestline Fleet Account that has already needed pricing corrections has a repeat-error credit added to the pricing correction on a tire invoice posted with no fleet discount.

| Pricing correction credit memos booked on the account before today and less than twelve whole months before today | Repeat-error credit |
|---|---|
| two or more | 25.00 |
| exactly one | 10.00 |
| none | nothing |

The count reads the account's credit memos whose credit reason is a pricing correction, on any invoice of the account, dated before today and less than twelve whole months before today; a pricing correction booked today is not counted.

## Boundaries

- One earlier pricing correction in the period: 10.00; a second: 25.00.
- A pricing correction booked twelve or more whole months before today is outside the period and not counted.

## Where the amount sits

Because a fleet invoice posted without the program discount is Crestline's billing error, make-good amounts are added to the pricing correction on a tire invoice that an account invoiced without sales tax received with no fleet discount at all. The correction starts from the restored discount (the fleet discount the ticket should have carried less the discount the invoice already carried). The limit of the invoice amount less the credit memos and early-pay discounts already on the invoice is applied last, after every make-good amount, and prevails over every other part of the correction rule, so a correction can fall below the restored discount only when that limit is lower; the correction is rounded half up to the cent once, after the limit.
